summary: Oxymetholone has a serious boxed warning in the United States for causing liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a medium score of 52 for liver risk and a low score of 21 for heart risk [M]. A similar drug named Oxandrolone also has a boxed warning in the United States for liver harm [4]. Another drug, Brexanolone, has a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm [5].
